upstream.description: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform

classification.analysis: LlamaIndex is a mature, widely-used open-source Python framework for building LLM applications over private data: it provides data connectors for ingesting documents/APIs/SQL, indexing structures (vector, graph, keyword), retrieval/query engines, and agent workflows, and integrates with over 300 LLM/embedding/vector-store providers via LlamaHub. Alongside the OSS core, the same org runs LlamaParse/LlamaCloud, a commercial platform for agentic OCR, document parsing, extraction, and hosted document agents. It's aimed at developers building RAG pipelines and document-processing agents, from a 5-line quickstart to fully customized retrieval stacks, and remains one of the most starred RAG frameworks in the ecosystem.

use_cases.title: Build a RAG pipeline over a folder of PDFs or docs in a few lines of Python
Swap in a local LLM (Ollama) and embedding model for a fully offline RAG stack
Parse and extract structured data from complex documents with LlamaParse
Persist and reload a vector index across sessions for a production knowledge base
